title.hr: Kontejner bez root ovlasti: root unutra, običan vani
title.en: Rootless containers: root inside, an ordinary user outside

concept.hr: Root u kontejneru preslikava se u neprivilegirani UID na domaćinu
concept.en: Root inside the container maps to an unprivileged UID on the host

summary.hr: Stvori datoteke u kontejneru bez root ovlasti i provjeri vlasnike na domaćinu: uid_map, podređeni rasponi, nobody za nepreslikane brojeve i usporedba s rootom.
summary.en: Create files from a rootless container and check their owners on the host: uid_map, subordinate ranges, nobody for unmapped IDs, and the rootful contrast.

title.hr: Kontejner bez root ovlasti: servisni korisnik

concept.hr: www (33) unutra je 100032 vani, a student njegovu datoteku ne može mijenjati
concept.en: www (33) inside is 100032 on the host, and student cannot change its file

title.hr: Kontejner bez root ovlasti: datoteka domaćina unutra
title.en: Rootless containers: a host file inside

concept.hr: Datoteka roota domaćina unutra je nobody (65534); root kontejnera je ne čita
concept.en: Host root’s file is nobody (65534) inside; container root cannot read it
